name: Glue Up
description_en:
Glue Up is association and professional-community management software, combining memberships, CRM, events, communications and finance. Its event tools are useful in the context of member identity, renewal and community activity rather than as an isolated ticket page. My Glue serves members while a manager application supports administration.

Current pricing presents annual packages and optional power-ups. An organization should scope membership operations, chapters, certifications, integrations and event needs together, since an event-only comparison can miss the larger setup and commercial commitment.
description_zh:
Glue Up 是协会与专业社区管理软件，结合会员、CRM、活动、沟通和财务。活动工具与会员身份、续费和社区参与相连，不只是独立售票页。My Glue 面向会员，管理应用支持后台。

现行价格为年度组合及可选增强项。组织需把会员、分会、认证、集成和活动需求一起定义，单看活动工具可能忽略整体配置与商业承诺。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect member records and renewal activity to event communications.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把会员记录与续费活动关联到活动沟通。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage ongoing groups and chapter operations under the selected package.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按所选组合管理持续分组及分会运营。

en: Run a member seminar using membership eligibility, invitations and finance records.
zh: 依据会员资格、邀请和财务记录开展会员研讨会。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Define membership and event rules, map existing records and pilot one renewal-to-event invitation flow.
steps.zh: 定义会员与活动规则，映射已有记录，试验一次续费到活动邀请。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual organization package with optional power-ups and scoped services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual displayed ranges: Professional $3,000–$6,500, Advanced $8,000–$18,500; Enterprise custom. Organization size, requirements and power-ups determine the proposal. Currency, transaction fees, capacity and exact services require confirmation; no free production entitlement established.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 展示年费区间：Professional $3,000–$6,500，Advanced $8,000–$18,500，Enterprise 定制，组织规模、需求及增强项决定提案。币种、交易费、容量及准确服务需确认，未核实免费生产权益。

sources.title: All-in-one Association Management Software • Glue Up
sources.research_notes_en: Association management platform joins membership, CRM, events, communications and finance; event tools are one part of the family.

sources.title: Affordable All-in-One Software Pricing | Glue Up
sources.research_notes_en: Annual Professional and Advanced ranges, Enterprise quote and power-ups for chapters, certification, branding/community/integrations; size/requirements affect quote.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Keep membership status separate from an event RSVP
sections.title_zh: 区分会员身份与活动确认
sections.en: The product describes member records, renewal flows, payments, directories and event invitations. For an illustrative association seminar, define who qualifies for member pricing, who pays for a group and which attendees receive reminders. A valid membership and a paid ticket are different facts; test an expired member and a renewed account against the event workflow. No membership, payment or event path was executed here.
sections.zh: 产品介绍会员记录、续费、付款、目录与活动邀请。例如协会研讨会，应定义会员价资格、团队付款人及接收提醒者。有效会员与已付票据是不同事实，应测试过期会员及续费账户在活动中的行为。本文未执行会员、支付或活动路径。

sections.title_en: Price the organization rather than only the next event
sections.title_zh: 按组织范围而非仅下一场活动定价
sections.en: Professional is displayed at $3,000–$6,500 yearly, Advanced at $8,000–$18,500, with Enterprise custom. The page states annual billing and variation by organization size and requirements. These ranges are not a firm quote or proof of a selected currency. Chapter management, certifications, community, branding/SSO and integrations are described as power-ups; confirm what the proposal includes.
sections.zh: Professional 展示年费 $3,000–$6,500，Advanced $8,000–$18,500，Enterprise 定制；页面说明年付且随组织规模及需求变化。区间不是确定报价，也未明确所选币种。分会、认证、社区、品牌/SSO 和集成作为增强项介绍，应确认提案包含内容。

sections.title_en: Plan record migration and operational ownership
sections.title_zh: 安排记录迁移与运营责任
sections.en: A connected association platform needs usable member identifiers, contact permissions, renewal dates and finance reconciliation. The vendor describes a demo, tailored proposal and onboarding, but advertised rollout times and daily effort are not independent measurements. Pilot a member import, a renewal and the resulting event communication before replacing the old system. Named accounting or LMS integrations need exact mapping and entitlement checks.
sections.zh: 关联协会平台需要可用会员标识、联系权限、续费日期及账务核对。厂商描述演示、定制提案和上线支持，但宣传上线时间和每日工作量不是独立测量。替换旧系统前，先试验会员导入、续费及活动沟通，具名财务或 LMS 集成需核对映射与权益。

sections.title_en: Use the broader platform only when the programme needs it
sections.title_zh: 按项目需要选择较广平台
sections.en: Glue Up merits investigation for membership-based organizations running continuing communities and events. A one-off public ticket sale may need a narrower service. Confirm payment fees, email/contact capacity, chapter access, cancellation, exports and restoration. No source-code license or self-hosted package was verified. Vendor adoption, retention and revenue examples were not independently validated.
sections.zh: 持续运营社区与活动的会员组织可研究 Glue Up，单次公开售票可能只需较窄服务。需确认支付费、邮件/联系人容量、分会权限、取消、导出及恢复。本次未确认源码许可或自托管服务包，客户采用、续费及收入案例未独立验证。

research_gaps: No import, membership renewal, payment, event, My Glue, LMS/accounting integration or export was tested.
Currency/quote, power-ups, contact/email limits, transaction fees, contract terms, source license, self-hosting and recovery remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
